result.reason: The added clause reaches the preferred insurance position: CGL at USD 1M/2M, E&O at USD 2M, cyber/privacy at USD 5M for processing Client data, statutory workers’ compensation, and certificates upon request. It preserves the unrelated force majeure provision. However, requiring all coverage to continue for one year after termination exceeds the playbook and is not narrowly tailored, particularly for CGL and workers’ compensation. Otherwise, the operative language is professionally drafted.
